description: This file defines structures and functions for parsing and retrieving cgroup controller information from /proc/cgroups in Linux, as part of the Prometheus procfs package.

methods.name: parseCgroupSummaryString
methods.description: Parses a single line string from /proc/cgroups into a CgroupSummary struct.

methods.name: parseCgroupSummary
methods.description: Reads and parses multiple lines of /proc/cgroups data into a slice of CgroupSummary structs.

methods.name: CgroupSummarys
methods.description: Method of FS struct that retrieves current cgroup controller information from /proc/cgroups.
